questions.question: What is the name of the southern half of the Pangaea supercontinent that existed about 300 million years ago?
questions.solution: Gondwana. Southern supercontinent 300Ma; India, Australia, Antarctica, Africa, South America.

questions.question: On 20 July 1969, with whom did American astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first human to land on the moon?
questions.solution: Edwin Aldrin. Apollo 11 Eagle lunar module; Armstrong first step, Aldrin second 20 July 1969.

questions.question: How many types of plate tectonic boundaries are there?
questions.solution: Three. Convergent, divergent, transform; plate interactions volcanism, earthquakes.
